details.flavorMarkdown: *Living serpents stir beneath a medusa's hood, while polished stones hang at the belt as reminders of unfinished sculptures.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Stoneward gaze

**Target:** Only a creature that can see this creature. One visible creature within 4 squares. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** physical.

**Limit:** Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Study an opening before the gaze, then reposition or use Basic Melee during its required pause. A target that cannot see the medusa is safe from this gaze.

**Encounter and conversation:** The medusa has been blamed for statues far older than its arrival and wants the true sculptor found.

**Habitat:** Settlement; frontier; contested road · **Communication:** Common and its community’s language

**Loot:** Ordinary carried gear and 8 coins; special rewards belong to the adventure.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-medusa


**Category:** Mortal · **Role:** Disabler · **CV:** 31

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stoneward gaze | Brawn | 1 Boon | 3 physical damage. | 5 physical damage. | 7 physical damage. Paralyzed 1. |

Use the attributes above for defenses named by incoming attacks. Same targeting, limits and costs apply; no opposed second roll.

### CV worksheet

**Reference damage:** 3/5/7

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.7

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.6 → 1.7: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=3.404, O=4.596. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [numbing strike](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/numbing-strike.md), [Warning Hiss](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/warning-hiss.md), [watch the opening](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/watch-the-opening.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.
